title: Atlassian - We are experiencing intermittent issues on Atlassian.com and Bitbucket Marketing pages
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: We are experiencing intermittent issues on Atlassian.com and Bitbucket Marketing pages
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2023-09-29T16:26:31.000Z
Resolved: 2023-09-29T20:27:18.153Z
Updates:

- 2023-09-29T18:42:34.761Z: investigating - We are still investigating intermittent issues with these two domains. We will provide more details within the next hour.
- 2023-09-29T17:44:20.044Z: investigating - We are still investigating intermittent issues with these two domains. We will provide more details within the next hour.
- 2023-09-29T16:26:31.773Z: investigating - We are investigating cases of degraded performance for Atlassian Cloud customers. We will provide more details within the next hour.
